annotations.title: Rename or move an app file

description: Renames or moves one file within the app, in the draft, keeping its content; a file already at newPath is overwritten. Other files that reference the old path are not updated (neblla_edit_file). Waits in that env's draft until neblla_promote "save" with the same env ("pro": the users); "discard" drops that whole draft.

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.
